name: indian_govt
density: Extremely cramped. Every pixel is occupied. Multiple competing visual hierarchies fight for attention. Navigation alone has 40+ links spread across mega-menus, sidebars, and a top utility bar. Marquee text scrolls important announcements across the top. Tables are the primary layout tool. Multiple banner ads for government schemes compete with the main content.
nav_style: Fixed top utility bar with language selector and accessibility links. Below it a full-width orange header with ministry logo. Below that a 8-category mega-menu where each category has 8-12 dropdown items. Also a left sidebar with citizen service quick-links. Also a breadcrumb trail on every interior page.
commercial_model: Public service. Zero ads. But the visual density of government scheme banners, helpline numbers, and social media buttons makes it feel cluttered regardless.
color_palette: Sarkari orange (#FF6600) and dark navy blue (#003366) are dominant. White page backgrounds. Red (#CC0000) for urgent alerts and notices. Yellow (#FFCC00) accent for highlighted schemes. Light grey (#F5F5F5) for alternating table rows.
typography: Arial and Times New Roman only — no web fonts allowed by government IT policy. Body text at 12px. Headings at 14-16px bold. Link text underlined everywhere. Dense line-height of 1.3.

pages.title: Home
pages.description: Ministry landing page with scrolling announcements marquee, featured government schemes grid, latest tenders sidebar, quick citizen service links, and important contacts

pages.title: About the Ministry
pages.description: Ministry history since independence, organizational chart, minister and secretary profile photos with bios, vision and mission statements in tables

pages.title: Schemes & Programs
pages.description: Full listing of active government schemes in a dense table with scheme name, launch date, budget allocation, beneficiary count, and status badges

pages.title: Tenders & Procurement
pages.description: Active tenders table with tender ID, department, value, submission deadline, and download link columns. Separate section for archived tenders.

pages.title: Contact Us
pages.description: Multi-column table of all department offices with address, phone, fax, email. Embedded Google Maps placeholder. Grievance registration form.
